method_working_name: PIC-DTA: Paired Interval-Censored Counterfactual Drug-Target Affinity
primary_question: Does a drug-conditioned WT-to-modification effect distribution learn true modification identity and one-sided paired censoring information better than conventional point regression and matched negative controls?

claim_boundary_before_results.permitted_language: preregistered algorithm candidate and mechanism test

frozen_data_scope.delta_definition: modified pKd minus WT pKd; positive means stronger modified binding

paired_interval_targets.WT_CAPPED_MODIFIED_CAPPED: no identifiable delta supervision; never substitute zero or a point value

loss.category_weighting: exact total weight equals combined lower-plus-upper total weight; lower and upper each receive half the exact total weight

VARIANT_CONSTRUCT_COLD.assignment: sort constructs by sha256('PIC-DTA-VARIANT|'+protein), then assign consecutive groups round-robin to folds 0-4

DRUG_SCAFFOLD_COLD.group: RDKit Bemis-Murcko generic scaffold; empty-scaffold drugs use canonical SMILES as an acyclic singleton group
DRUG_SCAFFOLD_COLD.assignment: sort scaffold groups by descending drug count then sha256('PIC-DTA-DRUG|'+group); greedily assign each group to the least-loaded fold, breaking ties by fold index

inner_validation.group_scope: same grouping unit as the outer protocol
inner_validation.selection: minimum validation loss for the variant-specific frozen objective

outer_train_only_preprocessing.drug_morgan: StandardScaler then PCA32 fitted on unique outer-training drugs; zero-pad if rank below 32
outer_train_only_preprocessing.wt_esm2: StandardScaler then PCA16 fitted on unique outer-training constructs
outer_train_only_preprocessing.modified_esm2: StandardScaler then PCA16 fitted on unique outer-training constructs for the direct-affinity control and reverse audits
outer_train_only_preprocessing.delta_mean_esm2: StandardScaler then PCA16 fitted on unique outer-training constructs
outer_train_only_preprocessing.delta_maxabs_esm2: StandardScaler then PCA16 fitted on unique outer-training constructs
outer_train_only_preprocessing.explicit_modification: StandardScaler fitted on unique outer-training constructs

model.modification_encoder: WT-PCA16 + delta-mean-PCA16 + delta-maxabs-PCA16 + explicit48 = 96 -> Linear64 -> GELU -> Linear32
model.effect_mean: linear modification main effect plus scaled 32-dimensional drug-modification dot product
model.effect_scale: Softplus of Linear64->32->1 over concatenated drug and modification latents, clamped to [0.02, 3.0]
model.identity_consistency: virtual zero-modification rows for each training drug must predict tau=0
model.device: CUDA if available without interrupting GNINA, otherwise CPU

frozen_variants.ZERO_TAU_WT_ECHO: tau is exactly zero; no fitting
frozen_variants.RIDGE_POINT_EXACT: RidgeCV on exact deltas using all frozen preprocessed features
frozen_variants.DIRECT_MUTANT_TOBIT: same neural encoders predict absolute modified pKd with exact-or-upper-censored Tobit likelihood; derive delta only where WT is exact
frozen_variants.WT_LOCAL_ONLY_INTERVAL: same effect model and parameter count; delta and explicit modification inputs are exact zeros
frozen_variants.SHUFFLED_MODIFICATION_IDENTITY_WITHIN_GE: same effect model; permute WT, delta and explicit modification feature rows within gene separately in train/validation/test using a frozen seed, leaving labels and drugs fixed
frozen_variants.NO_DRUG_CONDITIONING_INTERVAL: same effect model and parameter count; drug encoder input is exact zero
frozen_variants.FULL_POINT_EXACT_ONLY: full effect model trained only on exact delta rows
frozen_variants.FULL_PAIRED_INTERVAL: full effect model trained on exact deltas plus lower and upper bounds with identity consistency

primary_metrics.strict_direction: balanced accuracy and AUROC on exact deltas with |delta| >= 0.3 pKd

phase_a_signal_gates.gate_1: FULL_PAIRED_INTERVAL exact-delta MSE is lower than ZERO_TAU_WT_ECHO in VARIANT_CONSTRUCT_COLD
phase_a_signal_gates.gate_2: FULL_PAIRED_INTERVAL beats SHUFFLED_MODIFICATION_IDENTITY_WITHIN_GENE_INTERVAL on exact-delta MSE with cluster-bootstrap 95% upper bound below zero in VARIANT_CONSTRUCT_COLD
phase_a_signal_gates.gate_3: FULL_PAIRED_INTERVAL beats NO_DRUG_CONDITIONING_INTERVAL on exact-delta MSE with cluster-bootstrap 95% upper bound below zero in VARIANT_CONSTRUCT_COLD
phase_a_signal_gates.gate_4: FULL_PAIRED_INTERVAL beats FULL_POINT_EXACT_ONLY on weighted interval NLL with cluster-bootstrap 95% upper bound below zero, while exact-delta MSE is not worse by more than 0.01
phase_a_signal_gates.gate_5: FULL_PAIRED_INTERVAL strict-direction balanced accuracy exceeds 0.55 in both VARIANT_CONSTRUCT_COLD and BASE_GENE_COLD
phase_a_signal_gates.gate_6: all input, split, finite-prediction, parameter-count, unavailable/uninformative-label and test-label isolation audits pass

decision_rule.all_gates_pass: OPEN_FIVE_SEED_CONFIRMATION_AND_OFFICIAL_FEW_SHOT_COMPARISON; still do not claim SOTA before confirmation and external validation
decision_rule.any_gate_fails: PHASE_A_MECHANISM_NOT_SUPPORTED; retain null result and do not call PIC-DTA an algorithm innovation
decision_rule.independent_external_validation: PBCNet2.0 mutation set and/or another mutation-affinity dataset is mandatory after internal DAVIS development

required_outputs: out-of-fold predictions for every variant and protocol
input/output hashes and explicit claim boundary
hard_stops: never convert a capped pKd=5 observation into an exact delta
never use both-capped pairs as mutation-effect point labels
never change folds, variants, metrics or gates after viewing Phase A results
never use unpaired GCN2 in paired-effect training
never alter the immutable 888/480/24/384 target scope
never call an internal single-dataset result SOTA
